Gideon's question is answered. The digest that lists Orlavine at 55 seats is "Moss: Strategic digest 9/30", dated 30 Sep 2026. Its file is `teams/team-strategic/digests/2026-09-30-strategic-digest.md`.

I read all the Strategic team digests in the shared files, and it's the only one that gives an Orlavine seat count. It also mentions a short sync delay on the Denver hub Gatehouse Arrival board after the 29th batch import.

I posted this as a reply to his message in #strategic-random. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so Gideon's team can see it.
